title: Modesto Mystics Fair --- Free Entry
long_description:
Come join us for this free event Modesto Mystics Fair: a day of magic and fun with healers, psychics, tarot readers, and mystical vendors!

About this Event

Welcome to the Modesto Mystics Fair!
THIS IS A FREE EVENT! TICKETS ARE NOT REQUIRED FOR ENTRY.REGISTERING FOR THE EVENT ON EVENTBRITE SENDS YOU EVENT REMINDERS TO YOUR PHONE AND NOTIFIES YOU OF OUR FUTURE EVENTS!!
PLEASE REGISTER HERE ON EVENTBRITE TO HELP US PREPARE FOR THE EVENT WITH YOUR VIRTUAL RSVP
Join us for a day filled with magic, mystery, and healing. Explore a variety of vendors offering mystical treasures, psychic readings, Reiki and spiritual guidance. Immerse yourself in workshops and demonstrations to enhance your spiritual journey. Don't miss out on this enchanting event where you can connect with like-minded individuals and discover new tools to enhance your spiritual practice.
You will be able to find crystals, herbs, soaps, teas, healers, tarot readings, spirit guide readings, sound bowl meditations, food and much more! Plan on spending the whole day!
See you there!
